Projects

Ten projects across six sectors, each with the full pipeline from data to result.

Finance & Risk

Finance & Risk

Financial Distress Prediction (SHAP + LLM)

Predicts company financial distress from 9,284 SEC filings with XGBoost, then explains every prediction in plain English using SHAP and an LLM narrative layer.

Collect SEC filings→Engineer ratios→Train XGBoost / MLP / TabTransformer→Explain with SHAP→Generate LLM narratives
F1-macro 0.847 · AUC 0.963

What I learned: Learned to audit for label leakage rigorously — headline accuracy means nothing if the target circularly depends on the features.

PythonXGBoostTabTransformerSHAPOptunaOpenAI API
Finance & Risk

Credit Card Fraud Detection

Detects fraud across 284,807 anonymised transactions using a chronological train/test split and cost-based threshold tuning instead of raw accuracy.

Chronological split→Feature engineering→Train Logistic Regression→Cost-based threshold tuning→Evaluate on business cost
Evaluated on real business cost, not accuracy

What I learned: Learned that accuracy is meaningless on severe class imbalance (0.17% fraud rate) — the deployment metric has to be cost-driven.

Pythonscikit-learnLogistic RegressionCost-based tuning

Business Intelligence & CRM

Business Intelligence & CRM

FC Highbury — Salesforce CRM + Power BI

Consulting engagement building a Salesforce CRM and Power BI dashboards for a football club, benchmarked against an AI-generated dashboard on the same data.

Audit data quality→Build CRM objects & flows→Model star schema→Build Power BI dashboards→Benchmark vs AI dashboard
SLA compliance 33% → 100%

What I learned: Learned that AI tools synthesize fast across datasets but miss data-quality issues manual analysis catches, like a mis-scaled field.

SalesforcePower BIExcelStar-schema modelling

Applied ML & Statistics

Applied ML & Statistics

Fish Market Weight Prediction

Predicts fish weight from body measurements, comparing linear, interaction, and log-log regression models while resolving severe multicollinearity.

Explore data→Check multicollinearity (VIF)→Transform (Box-Cox/log)→Fit candidate models→Compare & validate
RMSE 50.3g · R² = 0.996 (log space)

What I learned: Learned to detect and resolve multicollinearity (VIF up to 2,062) instead of just chasing a low error number.

PythonstatsmodelsVIF diagnosticsBox-Cox transforms
Applied ML & Statistics

GDP Growth ML Bake-off

Compares six ML models forecasting GDP growth across five small open economies (Ireland, Singapore, Switzerland, Luxembourg, Netherlands), 2000–2024.

Collect panel data 2000–2024→Feature engineering→Time-series CV→Train 6 models→Compare R² / RMSE
Ridge Regression generalised best (Test R² 0.22)

What I learned: Learned that model complexity has to match dataset size — a regularised linear model beat XGBoost and a neural net here.

PythonRidge/RF/XGBoost/MLPTime-series CV

Environmental & Urban Analytics

Dublin Green Premium — ETL & Geospatial Analysis

Full ETL and geospatial pipeline linking Dublin property prices to air quality and green-space access across 92,254 properties.

Collect prices, air quality & green space data→ETL (PostGIS + MongoDB)→Geospatial join→OLS regression→Interactive Dash app
~15% price premium, top vs. bottom green quintile

What I learned: Learned to spot spatial confounding — affluent suburbs skewed the raw park-distance coefficient counterintuitively.

PostGISMongoDBGeoPandasDash/PlotlyOLSDocker

Operations Research

Operations Research

Flow-Shop Scheduling Optimisation

Solves a job-scheduling problem with the NEH constructive heuristic and validates it against an exact Integer Programming solver.

Code & notebook project — no exported charts
Define jobs & machines→Run NEH heuristic→Solve exact IP (PuLP)→Compare makespan→Validate
NEH matched IP-optimal makespan (53) exactly

What I learned: Learned that a well-designed heuristic can match exact optimisation on realistic instance sizes, at a fraction of the compute.

PythonPuLP (Integer Programming)NEH heuristic
Operations Research

Cow Grazing Management Simulation

An ODE-based simulation combining logistic pasture growth with cattle grazing dynamics to recommend optimal Irish dairy/beef stocking rates.

Model pasture growth (logistic)→Simulate grazing (ODE)→Sweep stocking rates→Compare to Teagasc benchmarks→Recommend rate
Optimal rate ≈ 7 cows/ha, matches Teagasc guidance

What I learned: Learned to calibrate a mechanistic simulation against real agronomic reference data rather than treat it as a black box.

PythonSciPy ODE solversNumPymatplotlib
Operations Research

Suez Canal Blockage Simulation

A discrete-event queueing simulation of Suez Canal vessel traffic, calibrated against the real 2021 'Ever Given' blockage.

Model vessel arrivals (queueing)→Calibrate to 2021 blockage→Monte Carlo simulate→Compare to literature→Validate recovery time
Recovery time 4.43±0.17 days vs. ~5-day published benchmark

What I learned: Learned that validating a simulation against real published outcomes is the strongest form of calibration evidence.

PythonMonte CarloDiscrete-event queueing
